Olivia —

Thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a short draft and a playbook excerpt (see attachments). High level summary below so procurement has bullets to work from:

Phased eviction (three operational phases)
- Phase A: Live prefix/KV cache invalidation — target completion: 0–5 minutes after request when under normal load. This ensures no new requests can resume using cached contexts.
- Phase B: Persistent object expiration — scheduled background job marks and removes persistent copies from hot storage. Target completion: 1–24 hours depending on dataset size and retention tier.
- Phase C: Forensic purge & custody handback — physical/immutable object purge + certification of deletion from archival stores. Target completion: 7–30 days; accelerated options available as an add-on with audit trail.

Tiered ephemeral windows
- Default ephemeral window: 30 days for application contexts.
- Short-window option: 7 or 14 days configurable per dataset/label. When requested for PHI, short-window mode disables off-cluster snapshots and sets immediate snapshot TTL to 0.
- Interaction with backups: Short-window mode excludes that dataset from scheduled persisted snapshots; if an exception is required, it must be requested in writing and triggers an elevated review.

Order-form language suggestions (short bullets for redlines)
- "Redwood will complete Phase A within 5 minutes, Phase B within 24 hours, and Phase C within thirty (30) days of receiving a valid deletion request, except as otherwise mutually agreed in writing."
- "For datasets designated as PHI, Customer may elect a seven (7)-day ephemeral window, which prevents Redwood from scheduling persisted snapshots that contain such data."
- "Upon completion of Phase C Redwood will provide a signed deletion certificate and an export of the deletion audit journal."

Attachments: medistra_sla_phased_eviction_draft.pdf, redwood-deletion-playbook-v2.docx

I can loop legal if you want line-by-line order form text. Would you like the accelerated purge pricing options surfaced now or post-procurement?

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Phased eviction & tiered ephemeral windows — clarifications

Darren / Olivia —

We can include an accelerated purge commitment as a contractual option with a constrained operational profile. Proposed commercial/operational terms:

- For datasets contractually designated as "High Risk / PHI", Customer may exercise a one-time accelerated forensic purge request per 12-month period that reduces Phase C to seven (7) business days.
- Preconditions: Customer must provide an authenticated deletion request via the agreed API or signed request form; Redwood will temporarily reserve additional compute I/O to ensure the expedited workflow (see playbook).
- Pricing: Accelerated purge is billable at a fixed one-time fee (suggested: $9,500) to cover expedited forensics and manual validation. We can waive the fee for enterprise contracts above an annual committed spend threshold.
- Certification: Redwood will issue a PDF deletion certificate and an accompanying machine-readable JSON manifest exported from the deletion audit journal. The PDF is intended for procurement/legal records; the JSON is for automated cross-reference with customer systems.

If that sounds reasonable I can add the exact order-form wording and mark it as an optional checkbox in the SLA annex.

Marissa
